channel.title: Central African Republic - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Central African Republic, every source cited.

item.title: Bangui floods prompt spiritual and public responsibility questions
item.description: Activist Sosthène Marius Dingombé questions the spiritual meaning of the deadly floods in the capital.

item.title: Sunu Assurance offers education sector protection
item.description: The insurance company met with private school and university leaders on October 29, 2026, to discuss risk prevention and student safety.

item.title: Bangui bank clients demand access to funds
item.description: Customers of the Caisses mutuelles de Centrafrique in Bangui's 4th arrondissement are frustrated by delays in accessing their money.

item.title: MLPC disowns Martin Ziguélé
item.description: The MLPC Bureau Exécutif stated Martin Ziguélé continues to act in their name despite being removed as party president.

item.title: BRDC calls November 13 protest in Bangui
item.description: The opposition bloc demands lower fuel prices and the release of civil society leaders.
